name: Compassion To Others
overview: Scripture reveals that compassion toward others is a vital expression of the Christian life, rooted in the love and kindness God has shown through Christ. Jesus exemplified compassion by caring for weary and scattered multitudes and urging His followers to treat others as they would want to be treated, fulfilling the law and the prophets. The fruit of the Spirit includes gentleness and goodness, which empower believers to bear one another's burdens and forgive as God forgave us, demonstrating tenderhearted kindness in practical ways.
